title: Merchandise Purchases — Tax Service Days: Counting by Tender
content:
For a refund of sales tax charged on the part a Finch Note paid on a Merchandise Purchases unit, the tax service days run from the purchase date to the request date, counted by the tender on the purchase record:

1. For a unit paid by **debit card or cash**, whose money left the customer on the purchase date, the tax service days are the calendar days from the purchase date to the request date, counting both dates.
2. For a unit paid by **bank credit card**, they are those calendar days not counting the purchase date.

A unit paid by any other tender is outside this rule.

*Hypothetical counts (purchase 10 April, request 30 April):* debit or cash, 21 days; bank card, 20 days.
